relevance_note: Case report of one infant with LAD-I and an ITGB2 variant: "Genetic analysis of CD18 revealed a homozygous mutation in ITGB2, viz. c.1835G>T; p.C612F".
method_note: Read the whole paper and wrote the JSON with a short Python script in the scratch directory; all values were transcribed by hand from my reading. In scope: the index patient; her mother (DNA extracted for testing, but no result reported, so no variant row); two previously published people with individual-level facts: the Fiorini case (ref 7; only described as 'a different mutation affecting the same amino acid' and a moderate flow-cytometry phenotype, so its variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported') and the first South American case (citation printed as '20-24' at the end of that paragraph, so the per-patient reference is uncertain; the age '4-month-old' is not stated as onset, diagnosis or last evaluation, so it was left out). Not given rows: the legal father and the presumed biological father (mother's older brother), who refused testing and is not described as affected; the paper also says DNA of the patient 'and her parents' was sent, contradicting 'DNA was extracted only from the patient and her mother'. Contradictions: the family 'reported non-consanguinity at first' but the pedigree revealed inbreeding (recorded consanguinity yes); 'showed no obvious dysmorphism' at birth vs 'facial anomalies detected during the second hospitalisation' (different time points; both rows emitted, no checklist item affected). The markdown prints '>' as '>'; spans keep '>' verbatim and the variant values use '>'. The variant is also printed as 'c.1835-G>-T' in the Investigations section. Variant type 'missense' rests on the authors' wording 'substitution of a phenylalanine for cysteine at amino acid 612', not on the HGVS string. Inheritance left 'not reported': the mother's test result is not given. Mother's consanguinity left 'not reported': she stated her parents are first cousins 'although this could not be corroborated in the pedigree'. Mother's age ('15 ... years old') refers to the time of the infant's admission, so it was not recorded as last evaluation. Patient cause of death left 'not reported': the paper does not state it explicitly (fulminant sepsis, then limitation of treatment, then death at home 7 days after discharge); age at death not stated. Table 1 (serial haematology) uses '-' with no legend; no values taken from it beyond the text. Toxoplasma IgG '<6.5' not recorded because it is unclear whether '(negative)' applies to it. Normal findings recorded as excluded abnormalities per D-27; the lab sentence about lymphocyte populations, immunoglobulins, complement and respiratory burst is split by Table 1 in the markdown, so its two parts are quoted as two separate spans. Checklist: 'otitis' and 'respiratory' infections are not specified as otitis media or lower respiratory tract, so those items are 'not reported'; 'impaired wound healing' marked observed from 'slow-healing lesions' of cutaneous candidiasis (uncertain).
